data.one_liner: A Dart library for parsing YAML documents into Dart data structures.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to load YAML strings or streams into Dart objects. It supports error recovery and detailed error reporting. The library does not support dumping YAML back to text.
use_when: Parsing configuration files in Dart or Flutter apps
Converting YAML data to Dart maps/lists for further processing
Reading YAML from network or local files
avoid_when: When you need to generate YAML output
When working with very large YAML files that require streaming parsing
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native dependencies
Supports error recovery with custom listeners
Maintained by dart-lang with regular updates
Compatible with all platforms (web, mobile, desktop)
weaknesses: Limited to parsing, not editing or serializing
Some edge cases (self-referential collections) still throw exceptions
